scope: Exact s169 partial support and rise references; not an integrated controller or native launch authority.
input: Actual source observation V3, descriptor, and independently validated partial phase. Full native ownership, source and energy validation belongs to the future distinct route.
native_loading: A foot qualifies only with native presence, bears_support, ordinary unilateral contact and impulse >= 0.019293 N s. Absent flags imply zero load for seeking even if a nonzero impulse is reported.

phase_behavior.establish_distal_support: Seek missing load. With all feet qualified, emit bounded measured hold; never request rise in this phase.
phase_behavior.raise_body: Use unchanged R10Z geometry rise only while all four feet qualify. On load loss seek support without resetting or extending any task clock.
phase_behavior.other_phases: Refuse; the future composition must dispatch unchanged V7 stance and terminal behavior.

target_rule: For each weak foot, lower its measured-pose modeled endpoint by 0.1 * dt * scale * clamp((0.019293 - qualified_native_impulse)/0.019293, 0, 1). Apply this even below any inferred plane; do not use inferred ground height as a substitute for measured load. Keep qualified feet endpoints fixed in the virtual calculation.

search.selection: First maximize feasible load-seeking scale, then minimize squared virtual translation plus 0.04 * squared level blend; keep first exact tie.
search.ik: Both analytic knee branches, nearest admissible branch; no unreachable cosine clamp.

fallback: Bounded measured hold if no feasible candidate or undefined horizontal heading. Record reason; never report this as support success.
missing_reference: Load-seeking uses observed feet and world vertical without inferring a terrain plane. No positive bearing reference is required; no contact is fabricated.
preserved: Native task threshold 0.019293 N s per foot
Motor/energy authority; ordinary joint commands only
Consumed historical populations and old controller behavior
required_checks: Four original exposed entries and selected retained R10Z states
All 240 retained R10Z support inputs before physical route qualification
Deterministic bounded targets and independent FK reconstruction
No lift in support or during rise load loss
Below-plane weak feet still seek load; full load in support holds
Small measured overshoot return without observation rewrite
Quaternion sign and world translation invariance
No feasible candidate retains explicit hold
validation_reuse: The unchanged R10Z reference first validates inputs and computes at most 135 candidates. Load seeking adds at most 60 candidates, for 195 total; only the new selected reference may be emitted during support.
